# tsuru_role_default (Resource)

Manages tsuru default roles: roles automatically assigned to a user when it is created, or to a user when it creates a new team. This is a singleton resource: there is a single default roles configuration per tsuru target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tsuru_role" "team_member" {
  name        = "team-member"
  context     = "team"
  description = "Default role assigned to new users"

  permissions = [
    "app.read",
  ]
}

resource "tsuru_role" "team_owner" {
  name        = "team-owner"
  context     = "team"
  description = "Default role assigned to the user that creates a team"

  permissions = [
    "app",
    "team.update",
  ]
}

# tsuru_role_default is a singleton resource: there is a single default
# roles configuration per tsuru target.
resource "tsuru_role_default" "this" {
  user_create = [tsuru_role.team_member.name]
  team_create = [tsuru_role.team_owner.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `team_create` (Set of String) Role names automatically assigned to a user when it creates a new team
- `user_create` (Set of String) Role names automatically assigned to a user when it is created

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tsuru_role_default.resource_name "default"

# example
terraform import tsuru_role_default.this "default"
```
